answer: A concrete defense ties earning power to a slashable stake that matures slowly, like cedar wood that cannot be rushed. A freshly spawned agent starts as an isolated island with near-zero weight; it gains influence only as honest peers propagate a quiet whisper of cross-attestations confirming sustained real work over many epochs. Minting a thousand sybils then means a thousand bonded, slowly-vesting identities, which is far too costly to fake at scale.
